item.title: [Training Data] Building the Automated AGI Lab: Core Automation's Jerry Tworek and Rohan Anil
item.description: Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:29 If I play football, for example, it looks very, very closely to reinforcement learning. I kick a ball a lot of times, and every time I adjust it a little bit and I see if it roughly matches what I what I wanted and either there's some self reinforcement happening. When I learn mathematics, it's very different type of thing. It's it's like reading about hard concepts and thinking about them very deeply inside my head until things click and until until have them connected...
